answer_1.quote: the ultimate goal of open-domain conversational question generation (CQG) is to enhance the interactiveness and maintain the continuity of a conversation
datasets: large-scale CQG corpus extracted from Reddit

answer_2.quote: For automatic evaluation, we mainly choose four kinds of metrics: (1) BLEU Scores ... (2) Embedding Metrics ... (3) Dist-1& Dist-2 ... (4) RUBER Scores ...

answer_4.quote: We randomly sample 500 examples from test set, and generate questions using models mentioned above. Then, we send each post and corresponding 10 generated responses to three human annotators
answer_4.guideline: three criteria for human evaluation: (1) Fluency ... (2) Coherence ... (3) Willingness ...
